description: Compares the early application plans of two to twelve selective colleges: Early Decision, Early Decision II, Early Action and Restrictive or Single-Choice Early Action, with deadlines, notification dates and whether each is binding, each with its source. Shows early admit counts next to overall counts only when a school published them, flags conflicts across the list (two binding Early Decision schools, binding plus restrictive early action), checks whether an Early Decision I answer arrives before an Early Decision II deadline, and adds what each school publishes about need-blind admission, meeting full need, its net price calculator and what releases a family from the binding agreement. Anything a school did not publish reads "not published". Works without sign-in.

colleges.description: Two to twelve college names, e.g. ["Brown", "Northeastern", "Boston University"]

edChoice.description: Optional: the one college the family is considering for binding Early Decision I.

needsAid.description: Optional: whether the family expects to need financial aid.

name: compare_early_plans
title: Compare early application plans
